title: Reliability and the Write-Ahead Log
summary: Write-ahead logging is a standard method for ensuring data integrity in PostgreSQL. Changes to data files are written only after those changes have been logged to permanent storage.

key_points.claim: Write-ahead logging is a standard method for ensuring data integrity in PostgreSQL
key_points.quote: Write-ahead logging is a standard method for ensuring data integrity in PostgreSQL.

key_points.claim: Changes to data files are written only after those changes have been logged to permanent storage
key_points.quote: Changes to data files are written only after those changes have been logged to permanent storage.

key_points.claim: After a crash, PostgreSQL recovers the database by replaying the log records
